title: Balanced comparison from principal completion of ordinary extension to the actual integral tower
statement: Let l, E, L, iota and Y be as for finite integral coefficient extension. Let phi:R_E -> R_L commute with the actual finite quotient projections and scalar maps [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, lem-weil-integral-scalar-extension-well-defined]. Let F be an ordinary/derived change-of-rings cochain Model for phi [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], and C any normalized principal quotient completion Model for R_L at its actual uniformizer [def-pur-principal-quotient-completion-model, lem-a1-principal-koszul-strict-replacement]. Suppose beta from termwise F.E to the actual integral scalar Roos complex has every prescribed finite tensor component s tensor x -> residue(s) tensor x and zero shifted-product component. Then there is a natural isomorphism c:F.T followed by C.completion -> the actual integral scalar extension [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension]. On every flat-term K-flat representative P, C.unit at F.T(QP), followed by c and the specified actual integral resolving comparison, equals F's derived counit at P followed by Q(beta at P). This comparison requires neither finite freeness nor completeness of the input.

proof.text: Identify the categorical principal cokernel with the actual residue module by completed_exact. Its cokernel projection followed by this isomorphism is the specified residue projection, which sends one to one.

Construct restriction/sheafification and tensor/sheafification comparisons at independent site and coefficient universes. The normalized scalar-extension adjunctions and identity-on-sections restriction-composition comparison give successive scalar-extension associativity. On pure generators the level isomorphism sends the quotient of s tensor x to residue(s) tensor x. The termwise tensor unitor is identified using lax monoidal unitality.

The single-complex tensor comparison identifies each quotient augmentation degree with the cokernel projection tensored with the input. Tensor preserves colimits, so these maps are epimorphic in every degree. Use the given beta quotient coordinates and the level isomorphisms to factor its product projections. Epimorphic cancellation proves compatibility with differentials, successive quotient transitions and every input cochain map. This gives a natural strict tower isomorphism. Apply the product cone functor, compare its mapping-cone and mapping-cocone presentations, and check both biproduct coordinates against C.coordinates and the zero shifted coordinate of beta.

Ordinary scalar extension preserves K-flatness, so F.epsilon and C.counit are invertible on the good representatives. Their composite with the strict Roos comparison yields the resolving isomorphism for F.T followed by C.completion. The uniqueness clause of integralScalarExtensionWellDefined compares it with the specified integral scalar extension. Naturality of C.unit, C.unit_computes and the augmentation identity prove the required equation.

theorem completedIntegralQuotientModelComparison
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra ℚ_[l] L] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] L]
    (ι : E →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] L) (Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{t})
    (φ : completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E Y ⟶
      completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l L Y)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, φ ≫ completedIntegralCommRingProjectionUnrestricted l L Y n =
      completedIntegralCommRingProjectionUnrestricted l E Y n ≫
        integralScalarQuotientSheafMap l E L ι Y n)
    (F : @SheafOfModules.DerivedChangeOfRingsCochainModel.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1),
      max u (t + 1) + 1, max u (t + 1) + 1}
      Y.ProEt inferInstance (essentiallySmallSelf.{u} _)
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) inferInstance
      (integralCoefficientAbLocallyBijective.{t, u} Y)
      (integralCoefficientAbSheafify.{t, u} Y)
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E Y)
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l L Y) φ
      (integralTowerHasDerivedCategory l E Y) (integralTowerHasDerivedCategory l L Y))
    (C : @PrincipalQuotientCompletion.Model.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1), max u (t + 1) + 1}
      Y.ProEt inferInstance (essentiallySmallSelf.{u} _)
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) inferInstance
      (integralCoefficientAbSheafify.{t, u} Y)
      (integralCoefficientAbLocallyBijective.{t, u} Y)
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l L Y)
      (integralTowerHasDerivedCategory l L Y)
      (PrincipalKoszulStrictReplacement.uniformizer l L Y))
    (β : F.E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⟶ integralScalarComplexFunctor l E L ι Y)
    (hβ :
      (∀ (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E Y) ℤ) (i : ℤ) (n : ℕ)
        (U : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ)
        (s : (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l L Y).obj.obj U)
        (x : (P.X i).val.obj U),
        (((β.app P).f i ≫
          (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.fst
            (towerTransitionEndomorphism
              (K := fun n ↦ ((integralScalarTowerFunctor l E L ι Y).obj P).obj (op n))
              (integralOperationsTowerStep ((integralScalarTowerFunctor l E L ι Y).obj P)))).f i ≫
          (Pi.π
            (fun n ↦ ((integralScalarTowerFunctor l E L ι Y).obj P).obj (op n)) n).f i).val.app U)
          ((eqToHom (F.obj_eq (P.X i)).symm).val.app U
            ((toSheafify (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology Y)
              (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf φ (P.X i)).presheaf).app U
                (s ⊗ₜ[(completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E Y).obj.obj U,
                  (φ.hom.app U).hom] x))) =
            integralScalarTensorSection l E L ι Y n (P.X i) U
              ((completedIntegralCommRingProjectionUnrestricted l L Y n).hom.app U s) x) ∧
      (∀ (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E Y) ℤ) (i : ℤ),
        (β.app P).f i ≫
          (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.snd
            (towerTransitionEndomorphism
              (K := fun n ↦ ((integralScalarTowerFunctor l E L ι Y).obj P).obj (op n))
              (integralOperationsTowerStep ((integralScalarTowerFunctor l E L ι Y).obj P)))).v
                i (i - 1) (by omega) = 0)) :
    ∃ c : F.T ⋙ C.completion ≅ integralScalarExtensionOfUniverses l E L ι Y,
      ∀ P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory,
        C.unit.app (F.T.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj)) ≫
            c.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj) ≫
            (integralScalarExtensionComparisonOfUniverses l E L ι Y).hom.app P =
          F.ε.app P.obj ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (β.app P.obj)
